items: BAYELSA STATE (PSI 9.4): Seals $100M+ Gas Gathering & Processing Deal with US-Based Fulcrum LNG at Texas Forum
BENUE STATE (PSI 9.2): EXCO Approves ₦2.9Bn NG-CARES 2.0, ₦2.3Bn Tertiary Salary Arrears, CONLESS & Gifts 254 Graduands ₦50k Each
LAGOS STATE (PSI 9.0): Deploys 11 Oando Electric Buses, Hosts Energy Summit 2026 for 24/7 Power & Trains School Bursars
CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 8.9): Prepares Bakassi Deep Seaport Groundbreaking by Tinubu & Delivers 8 Official Vehicles to Paramount Rulers
ENUGU STATE (PSI 8.8): Joins Under2 Coalition at COP31 in Türkiye & Commissions Ugbowa Type-2 Primary Healthcare Centre
KADUNA STATE (PSI 8.6): Completes Kabala–Costain to Aliyu Makama Road Dualisation & Bridge Extension Project
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 8.4): Lifts Curfew in Barkin Ladi, Bokkos & Mangu LGAs & Commits Over ₦1Bn to Tackle Malnutrition
NASARAWA STATE (PSI 8.2): Flags Off ICPC-NITDA LGA Websites Pilot & Disburses 2024/2025 Bursaries to 18,400+ Tertiary Students
EDO STATE (PSI 8.0): Marks Gov. Okpebholo's 2nd Anniversary with SDG/ESOPP Milestones, Anti-Bullying Drive & Oloma Inspections
ANAMBRA STATE (PSI 7.8): Opens Application Portal for Batch 3 of '1Youth 2Skills' Entrepreneurship Programme Across 21 LGAs
RIVERS STATE (PSI 7.7): Partners NLNG at 2026 Stakeholders Forum as GTS-1 Pipeline Corridor Achieves Zero-Vandalism Resilience
GOMBE STATE (PSI 7.5): Federal Fire Service Contains Gas Tanker Fire at Natsuwa Plant, Saving ₦40M Property
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 7.4): Works Commissioner Inspects 18km Girei–Pariya Road Project as Culverts & Surface Dressing Advance
EKITI STATE (PSI 7.2): Trains Young Innovators in Robotics, Coding & Web Design at Kids Innovate Summer Bootcamp 2.0
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 6.8): Gov. Lawal Mourns Passing of Commerce Commissioner Tasiu Musa Shinkafi
OYO STATE (PSI 6.5): Gov. Makinde Publishes Special Newsletter Outlining 2027 Presidential Bid & Policy Divergence

BAYELSA (PSI 9.4): Gov. Douye Diri sealed an agreement with US-based Fulcrum LNG Incorporated at the US-Nigeria Governors G2B Forum in Sugar Land, Texas, to build a multi-million-dollar flare gas gathering and processing facility powering Bayelsa's IPP and industrial clusters.

BENUE (PSI 9.2): Gov. Hyacinth Alia's EXCO approved ₦2.9bn for NG-CARES 2.0, ₦2.3bn for 12-month ASUTIBS salary arrears, 25–35% tertiary wage hikes, CONLESS for Assembly staff, ₦498.9m rural electrification variation, IPSAS LGA budgeting, and ₦50,000 gifts to 254 graduating students.

LAGOS (PSI 9.0): Gov. Babajide Sanwo-Olu rolled out 11 new electric buses (first batch of 50 with Oando Clean Energy), convened the Lagos Energy Summit 2026 around a Seven-Point Energy Agenda to meet 12,000MW demand, and trained Model College bursars on financial governance.

CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.9): Gov. Bassey Otu inspected the Bakassi Deep Seaport site ahead of President Tinubu's Nov 14 groundbreaking, expanding local artisan training, and presented 8 new official vehicles to paramount rulers while ordering immediate chieftaincy certificate processing.

ENUGU (PSI 8.8): Enugu State joined the global Under2 Coalition and showcased its Smart City project at COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye, while Gov. Peter Mbah commissioned a new Type-2 PHC in Ugbowa as part of a 260-ward healthcare rollout.

KADUNA (PSI 8.6): Gov. Uba Sani's administration completed the Kabala–Costain Road Dualisation and Bridge Extension via CCECC after inheriting it at 30%, correcting defective designs, settling ₦2.2bn in arrears, and committing ₦6bn in fresh funding.

PLATEAU (PSI 8.4): Gov. Caleb Mutfwang lifted the curfew across Barkin Ladi, Bokkos, and Mangu LGAs following restored peace, while Budget Commissioner Ishaku Maren announced over ₦1bn committed to multisectoral nutrition programs.

NASARAWA (PSI 8.2): Gov. Abdullahi Sule flagged off the ICPC-NITDA LGA Websites Pilot Programme in Lafia to boost grassroots digital transparency and initiated 2024/2025 bursary disbursements to over 18,400 tertiary students at NSUK Gudi Campus.

EDO (PSI 8.0): Edo agencies highlighted two-year SHINE Agenda gains in market solar boreholes and oil palm growth; First Lady's Office took anti-bullying advocacy to Idia College; and Akoko-Edo Chairman inspected Oloma school works and ordered health center reopening.

ANAMBRA (PSI 7.8): Anambra State Government opened registration through November 20, 2026, for Batch 3 of the 1Youth 2Skills Programme targeting residents aged 18–40 across all 21 LGAs for hands-on technical and vocational training.

RIVERS (PSI 7.7): Gov. Siminalayi Fubara, represented by SSG Dr. Dagogo Wokoma, joined NLNG MD Engr. Adeleye Falade at the 2026 Community Stakeholders Forum, celebrating host community protection of the Gas Transmission System 1 (GTS-1) corridor.

GOMBE (PSI 7.5): Federal Fire Service Gombe Command responded within 9 minutes to contain an LPG transfer fire at Natsuwa Gas Plant along Yola Road, preventing catastrophic escalation and saving ₦40 million in assets.

ADAMAWA (PSI 7.4): Adamawa Commissioner of Works Hon. Engr. Mohammed Suleiman and senior ministry engineers inspected the 18km Girei–Pariya Road project, verifying the completion of six culverts and ongoing surface dressing works.

EKITI (PSI 7.2): Ekiti State Ministry of Innovation, Science and Digital Economy, alongside Innovate Ekiti and Cybernetiq, delivered free practical robotics, coding, and web design training to children across the state.

ZAMFARA (PSI 6.8): Gov. Dauda Lawal issued an official condolence statement mourning the death of Zamfara State Commissioner for Commerce, Tasiu Musa Shinkafi, who passed away at age 50 in a Kaduna hospital after a brief illness.

OYO (PSI 6.5): Gov. Seyi Makinde released a special newsletter detailing four reasons for withdrawing support from President Bola Tinubu and outlining his platform ahead of the January 16, 2027 election.
